page_title: GET 1-2 VIL | Getafe v Villarreal 30/03/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+8' That's the end of the match.
90+5' Peter Federico (Getafe) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
90+1' Gooal! No wait, it's been ruled out for offside. Yeremy Pino (Villarreal) disagrees, but the linesman is sure about his call.
90' There will be a minimum of 6 min. of added time.
90' Diego Rico (Getafe) sends a chip pass into the box, but Junior Reis is quickest to intercept the ball.
89' None of the Villarreal players could reach the corner kick as the ball was overhit and goes out of play.
87' Yeremy Pino (Villarreal) was standing in a clear offside position, making it an easy call for the linesman.
85' Borja Mayoral (Getafe) is in a clear offside position and the referee blows his whistle after the linesman raises his flag.
82' Junior Reis (Villarreal) makes it easy for the referee to show him a yellow card.
80' Santi Comesana (Villarreal) is given a fully deserved yellow card.
80' Jose Bordalas Jimenez prepares a substitution. Omar Alderete is replaced by Allan Nyom (Getafe).
79' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Peter Federico (Getafe).
78' Sergi Cardona (Villarreal) is rightly booked by the referee because it could not have been anything other than a yellow card.
76' Substitution. Gerard Moreno (Villarreal) replaces Thierno Barry.
75' Yeremy Pino (Villarreal) picks up a long through ball, but David Soria deserves praise for a brilliant reaction and interception.
72' Marcelino has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Alfonso Pedraza (Villarreal) replacing Alex Baena.
72' Yeremy Pino (Villarreal) finds himself in an offside position and the referee stops play after the linesman raises his flag.
71' Alvaro Rodriguez (Getafe) unleashes a long-range free kick, but the goalkeeper does well to make a fine save.
69' Getafe have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
67' We are about to witness a subsitution. Alvaro Rodriguez (Getafe) for Juanmi.
67' Jose Bordalas Jimenez decides to make a substitution. Carles Perez will be replaced by Peter Federico (Getafe).
67' Substitution. Alex Baena walks off the pitch and Kiko Femenia (Villarreal) comes on as a substitute.
67' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Yeremy Pino (Villarreal) is coming onto the pitch as Tajon Buchanan cannot continue after picking up an injury.
66' Alex Baena (Villarreal) unleashes a shot towards the goal, but his effort isn't precise at all and it flies high over the bar.
65' The defence had a hard time blocking out the strike from Tajon Buchanan (Villarreal). He didn't hesitate and finished from outside the box right after he had received a pass from his teammate.
62' 2:0 – the corner kicks stats.
60' Dani Parejo (Villarreal) plays a through ball inside the box, but it's too strong and David Soria comes off his line to intercept.
58' Alex Baena (Villarreal) takes the ball, nicely zig-zags through the defence, but his shot to the right post is smartly dealt with by David Soria.
58' Luis Milla (Getafe) attempts to find the head of one of his teammates with a promising cross into the box, but a defender outjumps the attackers and averts the threat.
56' Thierno Barry (Villarreal) takes a shot from the edge of the box, but it's not a big threat for the goalkeeper as his effort is blocked by a defender.
54' PENALTY APPEAL by Villarreal, but the referee thinks it was a fair challenge and play continues!
53' A fine lofted pass into the box, sent by Ayoze Perez (Villarreal), is intercepted by the opposition's defence.
52' Getafe failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
51' Djene (Getafe) sends a beautiful cross into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence manages to clear the ball to safety.
50' Thierno Barry (Villarreal) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out.
48' Diego Rico (Getafe) plays a through ball which would have led to a great opportunity, if it hadn't been stopped by the defence.
46' The teams are back out for the second half and here is a change on the pitch. Jose Bordalas Jimenez gives a chance to Borja Mayoral (Getafe) and Coba Gomez da Costa is off.
46' Marcelino has decided to make a substitution during the half-time break. Logan Costa (Villarreal) comes on the pitch for Willy Kambwala.
46' Jose Bordalas Jimenez has made a change at the break. Juan Bernat (Getafe) has come on in place of Juan Antonio Iglesias Sanchez.
46' The second half has just started.
45+6' That is it for the first half after the referee blows his whistle and the players head to their respective dressing rooms.
45+4' The goal by Villarreal is DISALLOWED on the advice of the video assistant referee due to a handball.
45+3' Hold on! There’s a VAR review to see whether there was a handball in the build up to the goal. The referee is checking now. The Villarreal players aren’t happy.

45+2' Thierno Barry (Villarreal) finishes his beautiful individual effort with a superb strike from inside the box. David Soria is just a bystander as the ball flies into the bottom left corner. The score is 1:3.
45' We will have 3 min. of added time.
44' Carles Perez (Getafe) attempts to create a scoring opportunity with a wonderful long ball, but his pass is blocked.
43' Luis Milla (Getafe) commits a rough foul. Isidro Diaz stops the game and makes a call. A free kick has been awarded to Villarreal.
42' Carles Perez (Getafe) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
41' An attempted cross from Luis Milla (Getafe) is cleared.
39' Close! Omar Alderete (Getafe) picks up the ball in space and from inside the penalty area sends a shot narrowly over the bar.
39' Getafe have an opportunity from a mid-range free kick.
37' A player from Villarreal pulled an opponent down, forcing the referee to blow his whistle.
35' The foul by Thierno Barry (Villarreal) was seen by Isidro Diaz who didn't hesitate to blow the whistle.
33' 1 - 2 Thierno Barry (Villarreal) finds some space inside the box to meet a beautiful cross and fires the ball inside the right post. What a wonderful strike!
32' Djene (Getafe) sends the ball into the box from the side of the pitch, but his cross is blocked.
31' Willy Kambwala (Villarreal) gives the referee no choice but to show him a yellow card.
29' 1 - 1 Goal! Carles Perez (Getafe) pounced on a loose ball inside the box and beats the goalkeeper with a shot into the bottom left corner. He makes it 1:1.
27' A crossfield pass from Juan Foyth (Villarreal) fails to find any of his teammates.
25' Great teamplay by Getafe as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
24' Thierno Barry (Villarreal) is unable to control an accurate defence-splitting pass properly and one of the defending players reacts well to rob him of the ball.
22' Djene (Getafe) sends a promising through ball, but the defence is alert and cuts out the pass.
21' Alex Baena (Villarreal) delivers a long ball, but it lacks enough power to reach his teammates and is intercepted by one of the defenders.
20' The ball is cleared after Thierno Barry (Villarreal) attempted to dribble past an opposing player. The ball has crossed the sideline. Villarreal are taking a throw-in.
18' The players claim that Sergi Cardona (Villarreal) handled the ball and it seems they are right. Getafe are awarded the free kick.
17' The linesman signals a throw-in for Getafe.

15' 0 - 1 Goal! Tajon Buchanan displays great vision and sends a pass to Ayoze Perez (Villarreal), who shows brilliant composure inside the box to bury the ball into the bottom left corner. The score is 0:1.
13' The ball possession is 68:32.
10' Diego Rico (Getafe) receives a yellow card from the referee as expected.
10' Coba Gomez da Costa (Getafe) attempts to set up his teammate with a scoring opportunity by chipping in a fine pass from the edge of the box, but one of the defenders intercepts his effort.
10' That's unlucky! Juan Antonio Iglesias Sanchez (Getafe) beautifully controls a pass and from the edge of the box drills a shot in on goal, but it's inadvertently blocked by a defender and cleared.

8' Coba Gomez da Costa (Getafe) is obviously not following the Golden Rule: "Treat others as you want to be treated.“ He makes a bad challenge and leaves Isidro Diaz with no other option than to blow for a foul. Villarreal get a free kick.
7' Djene (Getafe) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender.
5' Mauro Arambarri (Getafe) crosses the ball into the box, but one of the defending players averts the threat.
3' Ayoze Perez (Villarreal) commits a rough challenge and Isidro Diaz blows his whistle for a foul. There is a free kick near the sideline to Getafe.
2' Luis Milla (Getafe) takes the corner, but one of the defenders reacts well and rises highest to head the ball away.
1' Here we go, today's match is starting right now.
The players are on the pitch and Getafe will have the kick-off.
Isidro Diaz will referee today's match.
Show lineups You can have a look at the starting XIs of both teams in the details of this match.
